subject: Invoice dispute: March usage spike and collection hold request
messages:
From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@nimbushealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice #INV-20270325 — request to pause collection + investigation

Hi Elliot,

Our accounts team just received invoice INV-20270325 for $58,200 and flagged a large spike in line items that look like duplicate connector ingest events between 2027-03-15 and 2027-03-22. That jump nearly doubled our expected spend for the month.

Can Redwood:
- Pause any collections or automated dunning for this invoice while we investigate?
- Provide a usage export and the raw connector logs for the March window (we need it for our procurement audit).
- Confirm VAT treatment — the invoice shows VAT applied to a US legal entity; we need the VAT registration used so we can reconcile with our tax team.

Given the size of the adjustment we may ask for a goodwill credit or a partial credit memo if this was an ingestion duplication on Redwood's side. We intend to pay the undisputed portion promptly but request a short hold on the remainder.

Attaching our internal summary (usage_summary_20270325.csv). Please advise next steps and an expected timeline.

Thanks,
Emily Santos
VP Finance, Nimbus Health
emily.santos@nimbushealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice #INV-20270325 — request to pause collection + investigation

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and for the CSV. Sorry for the disruption here.

I’m looping in Marissa (Finance) and Ben (Sales Ops) to stand up an expedited review. Immediate actions from our side:
1) I can request a provisional hold on automated collections for 7 business days while we investigate (we won’t mark the invoice as disputed in AR until Finance confirms).
2) Ben will run an ingestion audit to confirm whether connector events were duplicated.
3) Marissa will confirm the VAT registration used on the invoice and the steps to issue a credit memo if needed.

Can you share the PO/contract number you have on file and the VAT reg certificate when convenient — that will speed Finance’s reconciliation.

I’ll update you by EOD tomorrow with next steps and an ETA for the audit.

Best,
Elliot Price
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@nimbushealth.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice #INV-20270325 — request to pause collection + investigation

Hi Emily / team — I’m Marissa on Redwood Finance. Thanks for raising this. Quick note on process and what we need to move a credit memo: 

Required from Nimbus to process an adjustment: 
- Signed PO or contract reference (PO#: if available)
- VAT registration certificate (if you claim reverse-charge or need VAT reclassification)
- Confirmation of the disputed amount (for our ledger reflow)

If the audit confirms an overcharge attributable to us, we typically do: 
- Issue a credit memo applied to the invoice or as a standalone credit (you can elect which you prefer)
- Credits > $5k require a manager sign-off and take 3–5 business days to post + appear in your next statement cycle

As a provisional accommodation, we can hold collections for up to 10 business days from today while the audit completes. On the goodwill side, we can provisionally propose up to 20% credit on the disputed portion subject to confirmation of duplication. If the ingestion audit shows a different root cause we’ll adjust accordingly.

I’ve attached a draft credit memo template for your reference (credit_memo_draft_ell-20270330.pdf). Once we have the supporting docs we’ll finalize and route for approval.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Santos <emily.santos@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice #INV-20270325 — ingestion audit results (preliminary)

Hi all — I ran an initial ingestion audit against Nimbus’s connector activity and saw duplicated ingestion windows on 2027-03-17 and 2027-03-19 that align with the spike Emily reported. The raw audit is attached (ingestion-audit-2027-03-28.txt).

Preliminary findings: 
- ~$9,850 of the $58,200 appears attributable to duplicated ingest (approx. 17.4% of the invoice).
- Root cause looks like a retry loop triggered by an upstream connector timeout — we’re tracing whether that was caused by a backfill job or a connector config change on Nimbus’s side.

Recommendation from Sales Ops: 
- Approve an interim credit of 18% on the affected line items as a goodwill gesture while we finish the root-cause. It’s slightly above Finance’s provisional 20% cap applied to the disputed portion but keeps the math simple.
- Offer a 30-day payment deferral on the disputed remainder once we issue the credit memo so your cash team can schedule payment.

If that sounds reasonable, Marissa can finalize the credit memo and I’ll provide the technical RCA for your engineers.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice #INV-20270325 — ingestion audit results (preliminary)

Thanks Elliot / Marissa / Ben — we appreciate the quick triage and the audit.

Nimbus accepts the proposed 18% credit to the affected lines and the 30-day deferral on the disputed remainder. We will upload our VAT registration certificate and the PO# to the Drive link you shared by EOD today.

Please send the finalized credit memo and a DocuSign link so we can sign and close this out. Once the credit memo posts we’ll schedule payment for the undisputed balance immediately and the deferred remainder within the 30-day window.

Emily Santos
VP Finance, Nimbus Health
